title: Precision and Recall
outcome: By the end, I can explain precision and recall using a traced example and a stated limitation.
scenario: Put precision and recall denominators on the picture instead of memorising names.
given: Positive means spotted. TP=6, FP=2, FN=4, TN=8 in twenty fictional leaves.
All inputs and outcomes in this worked example are invented classroom data; no real model run is claimed.

steps.label: Keep goals separate
steps.detail: Precision asks how reliable flags are; recall asks how many spotted leaves were caught.

explanation: Read the picture in order. Precision asks how reliable flags are; recall asks how many spotted leaves were caught. The arrows show which recorded input or intermediate result each decision uses. Explain the deciding step aloud before checking the changed case; pointing to the final answer alone does not show how it follows.

counterfactual.change: Correct two false negatives into true positives.
counterfactual.reason: TP becomes8 and FN 2; FP remains2, so the two denominators happen to equal10.

student_task: Were the original precision and recall denominators the same? Point to the relevant step in the picture, then write the changed result and the rule or evidence that supports it.
teacher_answer: No. Precision used8 predicted-positive leaves; recall used10 actual-positive leaves. Their meanings remain distinct even when numbers later coincide. Changed-case check: Precision becomes8/10=80%; recall becomes8/10=80%. TP becomes8 and FN 2; FP remains2, so the two denominators happen to equal10.
project_evidence: For your Responsible Plant Classifier, save the input, procedure, observed result and limitation of this check. Label this worked example as practice; use a different, previously unreviewed case when checking independent understanding.
limits: If a relevant denominator is zero, report that metric as undefined under the chosen convention rather than silently inventing success.
review_note: Reviewed Precision and Recall against the assigned lesson pack and its reserved independent case. Added a different explicit worked scenario, an auditable trace and a changed-input check; preserved the original curriculum and assessment boundary.
